page.title: Asset protection, marriage, and divorce
page.summary: Strategy to protect assets, organize obligations, and reduce uncertainty in complex family decisions.
page.intro: Asset protection requires order, sensitivity, and carefully designed documents. We support preventive and disputed matters so each decision has a clear legal frame.

cards.title: Asset map
cards.description: We identify assets, obligations, risks, and key documents before proposing a path.

cards.title: Negotiation or defense path
cards.description: We define when to negotiate, formalize, or litigate, without promising outcomes that depend on third parties.

cards.title: Orderly closure
cards.description: We aim for clear, enforceable agreements that respect the family context.

page.trustTitle: Before acting, the matter is organized.
page.trustDescription: Each service starts with context, scope, and a responsible route. Sensitive information is requested only when the channel and objective are clear.

trustItems.title: Clear method
trustItems.description: Facts, documents, deadlines, and risks are separated before recommending an action.

trustItems.title: Information care
trustItems.description: The first contact stays general until scope and channel are confirmed.

trustItems.title: Multilingual attention
trustItems.description: The first approach can be prepared in Spanish, English, or Chinese depending on the matter.

page.moduleTitle: Order before deciding, negotiating, or litigating.
page.moduleDescription: Asset strategy combines inventory, documents, family scenarios, and legal effects to reduce uncertainty.

moduleItems.title: Assets and obligations map
moduleItems.description: Assets, debts, agreements, risks, and documents supporting each decision are separated.

moduleItems.title: Family scenario
moduleItems.description: The route considers involved people, possible agreements, and reasonable negotiation limits.

moduleItems.title: Formal route
moduleItems.description: When negotiation is not enough, the file is prepared for an orderly defense.

page.ctaTitle: Share the context before deciding the route.
page.ctaDescription: Astra Legal can review general context and identify a responsible next step. Do not send sensitive documents until the channel and scope are confirmed.
